preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner address)
Attacker must have some token balance to demonstrate exploitation

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the issue() function to mint unlimited tokens to yourself, increasing your balance without any collateral. This exploits the centralized control where the owner can arbitrarily inflate the token supply. The attack requires being the owner (or compromising the owner's private key).
